title: Filteredness of the pair henselization category
statement: For a commutative ring B and ideal J, let C be the full category of ring maps B to D with Spec(D) to Spec(B) etale [def-weil-etale-morphism] and the canonical map B/J to D/JD bijective, with all B-algebra maps as morphisms. Then C is filtered: it is nonempty, any two objects admit a common successor, and every pair of parallel maps is coequalized.

proof.text: The identity B-algebra is an object. Spec sends its identity to the identity, which is etale. The induced quotient map is injective by Ideal.quotientMap_injective' and surjective by Ideal.quotientMap_surjective. This gives nonemptiness of the full subcategory.

For objects C and D, take C tensor_B D and its two factor maps. The existing proved Algebra.Etale.tensorProduct instance is base change followed by composition. To verify the quotient condition, turn the canonical quotient maps B/J to C/JC and D/JD into algebra equivalences. Compose their inverses with the quotient projections and use the tensor universal property to obtain a map C tensor_B D to B/J killing J. Descend it to the quotient and check the two inverse identities using quotient and tensor extensionality. This fully proved private helper quotient_tensor_bijective shows that the tensor product is an object. Package the factor maps as morphisms of the under category and then of its full subcategory.

For parallel maps f,g:C to D, put S=C tensor_B C, m:S to C the multiplication, k:S to D the map c tensor c' to f(c)g(c'), and T=D tensor_S C. This is the diagonal-base-change presentation of the same coequalizer as the source. The multiplication map is etale by cancellation because S and C are etale over B; its base change D to T is etale, so B to T is etale by composition. The quotient of S by J is B/J by quotient_tensor_bijective. In a tower B to S to A, extension of J composes (Ideal.map_map), and the quotient maps compose. Cancel the bijective map B/J to S/JS: the fully proved private helper quotient_tower_bijective_iff yields that the quotients of D and C by JS are both S/JS. Apply quotient_tensor_bijective over S to T, then compose back to obtain B/J to T/JT bijective. Finally, tensor balance for c tensor 1 and 1 tensor c in S gives f(c) tensor 1 = 1 tensor c = g(c) tensor 1 in T. Extensionality in rings, the under category, and the full subcategory shows f followed by D to T equals g followed by D to T. The three constructions give IsFiltered.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0A02, directedness paragraph; diagonal-base-change presentation of its coequalizer; source read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0A02

mathlib_searches.query: A filtered colimit of etale ring algebras inducing the same quotient by an ideal is a henselian pair

lean.statement: theorem pair_henselization_filtered (B : Type u) [CommRing B] (J : Ideal B) : IsFiltered (ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory (fun C : Under (CommRingCat.of B) ↦ AlgebraicGeometry.Etale (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map C.hom) ∧ Function.Bijective (Ideal.quotientMap (J.map C.hom.hom) C.hom.hom (Ideal.le_comap_map))))
